name: Date Invitation
description: A romantic invitation to a date — playful yes/no page, handwritten letter, date & time picker, a convincing mini-game, and a final confirmation with a song.

sections.subtitle: Who's asking, and who's being asked?

sections.subtitle: Say why you want to take them out

askEyebrow.placeholder: I have something to ask you…
askEyebrow.default: I have something to ask you…

askQuestion.label: The question
askQuestion.placeholder: Will you go out with me?
askQuestion.default: Will you go out with me?

askSubtitle.label: Subtitle under the question
askSubtitle.default: There's a little plan I've been carrying around in my head for a while. And it involves you.

letterBody.label: Letter body
letterBody.default:
I've been trying to figure out how to say this without sounding like a fool. So I'm just going to say it: I really like you. Not in a small way — in the kind of way where I think about what you'd say to something before I even do it.

I'd like to take you somewhere. Somewhere quiet. Somewhere where we can talk and laugh and not check the time. Just us, for a few hours.

If you say yes, I promise to make it a day you'll remember.
letterBody.help: Separate paragraphs with a blank line.

whenSubtitle.label: Date page subtitle
whenSubtitle.placeholder: Pick a day and a time…
whenSubtitle.default: Pick a day and a time — I'll plan everything around it.

gameSubtitle.label: Game instructions
gameSubtitle.default: Catch 10 hearts in 30 seconds. Each one is a reason to say yes.

gameWin.label: Win message
gameWin.default: You caught every one. And you've made me the happiest person alive. ♥

gameLose.label: Lose message
gameLose.default: Almost! Try again — the hearts are worth catching. 💕

finalBody.label: Final message
finalBody.default: Bring yourself. Bring your laugh. Bring your stories. Everything else — I'll take care of.

finalVenue.label: Where? (optional)

finalVenue.default: A little café with fairy lights
